purpose: Illustrative triage, not a validated predictor or regulatory standard; manufacturing is a preliminary developability proxy

scale.direction: higher is more favorable for every dimension

legacy_mapping.toxicity: safety; inverse hazard direction, not raw toxicity

missing_policy: null rating => null total and provisional score; independent hard blocks may still require blocked disposition; never impute or renormalize

efficacy.4: orthogonal and cellular support with stronger activity; replication assessed separately
efficacy.5: replicated disease-relevant efficacy with exposure/engagement evidence

safety.3: limited preliminary screens without decisive hazard
safety.4: broader preliminary support; long-term safety unknown
safety.5: comprehensive qualified evidence for intended stage

bbb.4: stronger in vitro transport; in vivo unbound exposure missing
bbb.5: measured adequate unbound CNS exposure linked to activity

manufacturing.5: qualified reproducible process for intended stage
